trophies.name: Vice Got a Price!
trophies.guide: Unlock every other trophy in Grand Theft Auto VI to earn this platinum. Treat it as your final checklist: finish the story, clear all required activities, collectables, and challenges, then mop up any remaining task-specific trophies. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Just Like Paradise
trophies.guide: Complete the opening mission Gone Fishing. Follow the mission objectives as they appear and see the mission through to its completion. This is part of early story progression and should not be missable. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Paradise Lost
trophies.guide: Finish every required mission in Chapter 1 to reach the chapter completion point. Keep advancing the main story until the chapter closes. Story chapter completion trophies are earned through normal progression. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: T**s Ass Drug Money
trophies.guide: Progress through the main story and complete Chapter 2. Focus on the required chapter missions and finish the final objective that marks the chapter as done. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Vice City, Baby!
trophies.guide: Complete all required missions in Chapter 3. Continue following the main questline until the chapter concludes. This is a story progression trophy earned by finishing the chapter. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Top Of The World, Ma
trophies.guide: Reach and complete the end of Chapter 4 by finishing its required story missions. Stay on the main path until the chapter completion trigger fires. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: You Gotta Know When to Get Off
trophies.guide: Finish the game's final mission. This gold trophy comes from completing the main story's concluding objective. Prepare with good weapons, health, and a reliable vehicle before starting the finale. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Trust
trophies.guide: Complete the story mission named Breakfast Run. Accept or reach the mission in the main campaign, follow its objectives, and finish it successfully. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Break the Bank
trophies.guide: Complete The Cartel Heist mission. As a heist mission, expect multiple objectives such as entering, securing the target, and escaping. Complete every objective until the mission is marked finished. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Family Matters
trophies.guide: Finish the mission Child's Play during the story. Follow the mission markers and complete the required objectives to earn the trophy. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: DWNFALL
trophies.guide: Complete Headliners in the main campaign. Proceed through the mission objectives and make sure you reach the mission completion screen or checkpoint. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Hi-Jacked
trophies.guide: Complete VCIA Takedown. The mission name points to an operation at VCIA; follow the story objectives in that location and finish the mission. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Snow Storm
trophies.guide: Finish Operation Savage Glory. Complete each objective in the mission and stay alive until the operation concludes. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: A Long Road
trophies.guide: Reach 100% completion in the game. This usually means finishing required story content, side activities, collectibles, and other completion categories tracked by the game. Use the in-game completion checklist and clean up missing categories before the finale if possible. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Cunning Stunts
trophies.guide: Perform 250 stunts. Look for ramps, jumps, and stunt-friendly terrain while traveling around Leonida. Track your progress and repeat easy stunt spots if needed. A fast vehicle or bike can make jumps easier to complete consistently. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Master of None
trophies.description: Try each type of activity once.
trophies.guide: Try every activity type at least once. The official description indicates there are multiple activity types; complete one instance of each category rather than mastering them. Keep a simple checklist of activity types as you discover them. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Shootist
trophies.description: Earn a gold medal in all Shooting Range challenges.
trophies.guide: Earn a gold medal in every Shooting Range challenge. Practice weapon handling, accuracy, and target priority. Replay ranges until you hit the gold threshold; learn each range layout and use controlled bursts for better precision. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Top Fun
trophies.description: Win a Top Fun Drone Race at every location.
trophies.guide: Win one Top Fun Drone Race at each drone race location. Visit every race location marked for Top Fun Drone Races and place first at least once per location. Clean flying lines and avoiding obstacles matter more than risky shortcuts. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Earn Cash, Not Kudos
trophies.guide: Win 20 different races. Make sure each win counts as a different race event, not the same race repeated 20 times. Use a vehicle suited to the race type and learn the track layouts for consistent finishes. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Baited My Tackle
trophies.description: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge.
trophies.guide: Beat Cal in a fishing challenge. Find the fishing challenge involving Cal, start it, and score better than Cal by the end of the challenge. Pay attention to the challenge rules and timing prompts during the fishing minigame. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Stick Fiddler
trophies.guide: Complete one arcade game. Locate an arcade machine in the game world, start a playable arcade game, and finish it to completion. Any single completed arcade game should satisfy the requirement. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Road to Rehabilitation
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Andy.
trophies.guide: Finish Andy's final mission. Complete the full mission strand for Andy until his last mission is done. If the strand has prerequisites, clear them first and then complete the final mission objective. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: This Was No Boat Accident
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Kenton.
trophies.guide: Complete Kenton's final mission. Progress through Kenton's mission chain and finish the last mission in that strand. Watch for mission unlock conditions between steps. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Lone Rider
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Billy.
trophies.guide: Finish Billy's final mission. Work through Billy's available missions in order and complete the concluding mission of his strand. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Strangers & Freaks
trophies.description: Complete 8 mission strands for strangers across the state of Leonida.
trophies.guide: Complete eight stranger mission strands across Leonida. A strand means the full set of missions for a stranger, ending with that stranger's final mission. Track which strangers you have fully completed, not just started. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Supply & Demand
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Randy.
trophies.guide: Complete Randy's final mission. Advance Randy's mission strand to its end and finish the last mission. Keep checking for follow-up missions after each completion. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Spin On This!
trophies.description: Complete the final mission for Tyrone.
trophies.guide: Finish Tyrone's final mission. Complete every mission in Tyrone's strand and clear the final mission objective. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Positive Mental Attitude
trophies.description: Meditate at every spot across Leonida.
trophies.guide: Meditate at every meditation spot across Leonida. Find each meditation location and interact with it until the meditation action completes. Because this is an all-locations task, keep a map or checklist of spots you have already visited. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Fair Game
trophies.description: Hunt a unique animal for Bret.
trophies.guide: Hunt the unique animal for Bret. Start the relevant activity or mission from Bret, locate the unique animal target, and complete the hunt objective as instructed. Bring appropriate weapons and approach carefully to avoid losing the target. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Don't Touch My Deck
trophies.guide: Complete three collectible card sets. Find all cards required for each of three different sets. Track set progress separately so you know which cards are missing. This is a collectible/completion trophy, so systematic exploration helps. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: You WAiNKer!
trophies.guide: Use the WAiNK It action at 100 different locations. Visit locations across Leonida and perform the WAiNK It interaction where available. Keep count as you go; combining this with normal exploration reduces backtracking. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: One Last Thing
trophies.guide: Complete 50 challenges. Check the in-game challenge list and finish any 50 challenges across available categories. Prioritize easier or naturally completed challenges first, then clean up harder ones. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Hot Together
trophies.description: Lose a 4 star Wanted Level with your partner and escape the heat.
trophies.guide: With your partner present, raise your wanted level to four stars, then evade police and lose the wanted level completely. Plan an escape route, use fast vehicles, alleys, or off-road paths, and avoid getting boxed in. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Retail Therapy
trophies.description: Rob 3 shops back-to-back with your partner without losing your Wanted Level.
trophies.guide: Rob three shops consecutively while your partner is with you, and do it without losing your wanted level between robberies. Choose shops close together, plan a quick route, and keep control of the situation so the wanted state continues through the third robbery. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Whip It Good
trophies.guide: Discover 100 vehicles. Drive, enter, or otherwise register vehicles as you encounter them across Leonida. Variety matters, so explore different neighborhoods, parking areas, and mission locations to find new vehicle types. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Gunslinger
trophies.description: Take down 5 enemies in a single use of Combat Focus.
trophies.guide: Defeat five enemies during one activation of Combat Focus. Build the ability, enter a combat encounter with at least five enemies, activate Combat Focus, and eliminate five targets before the ability ends. A crowded combat area makes this easier. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Catch Me If You Can
trophies.description: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA.
trophies.guide: Make an unscheduled departure at VCIA. Travel to VCIA and leave in a way that isn't a normal scheduled departure — the description suggests improvising an exit, such as taking an aircraft or vehicle without following normal airport procedure. Expect a wanted response and be ready to escape. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Challenging Tank
trophies.guide: Deal with Rhinos, the tank vehicles referenced by the trophy name. Find or trigger an encounter involving Rhino tanks and survive or handle the situation as required by the game. Heavy weapons, explosives, and cover help when facing armored vehicles. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Sneakthief
trophies.description: Rob a jewelry store without being detected.
trophies.guide: Rob a jewelry store while remaining undetected. Scout the store, avoid cameras and guards, and use stealth to complete the robbery without triggering detection. If you are spotted, reset and try again with a quieter approach. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Maximum Withdrawal
trophies.guide: Rob five bank vaults and successfully escape after each robbery. Plan each heist carefully: secure the vault, manage alarms or resistance, and reach a safe getaway. Track which bank vaults you have already robbed so all five count. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: A Classic Blitz Play
trophies.description: Rob an Armored Truck and escape.
trophies.guide: Rob an armored truck and get away. Locate an armored truck in the world, disable or breach it, take the cash, and escape the response. A strong getaway vehicle and a planned route make the escape easier. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Goodtime State
trophies.guide: Explore all of Leonida. Visit every area/region required by the game's exploration tracking until the full map is considered explored. Use vehicles, boats, or aircraft to reach remote areas and check your map for any unexplored zones. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Pest Control
trophies.description: Rob an Illegal Operation belonging to each gang.
trophies.guide: Rob one illegal operation owned by each gang. Identify the gangs that run illegal operations, locate one operation per gang, and complete a robbery at each. Keep a checklist by gang so you don't repeat the same gang while missing another. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: In The Beginning…
trophies.description: Enjoy a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach.
trophies.guide: Have a cocktail with a view on Ocean Beach. Go to Ocean Beach, find a spot where you can order or enjoy a cocktail with a view, and complete the interaction. This is a simple location-based activity trophy. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Capital Offense
trophies.description: Smash your way out of a vehicle showroom in classic style.
trophies.guide: Escape a vehicle showroom by smashing your way out in classic style. Enter a vehicle showroom, get into a vehicle, and drive through the exit/glass in a dramatic escape. Be ready for a wanted level after the smash. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Let’s Go Bowling
trophies.description: Follow-through at the Kolt & Associates' bowling alley.
trophies.guide: Visit the Kolt & Associates bowling alley and complete the bowling activity/follow-through required. Go to the named location, start a bowling game, and finish the action the trophy calls for. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Personal Best
trophies.guide: Earn this trophy by reaching the partnership moment described by the game. The official description is intentionally brief; follow story and partner-related activities and complete the milestone when it becomes available. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Actions Speak Louder
trophies.guide: Make choices during the game as prompted. The official description indicates this tracks decisions over time; play naturally, respond to choice moments, and continue progressing until the trophy unlocks. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Bad Luck, I Guess
trophies.guide: Succeed on a second attempt. The description suggests failing once and then completing the same task successfully on the next try. Any activity where you can retry should work — fail intentionally or naturally, then complete it on the second attempt. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: The Truth Is Out There
trophies.guide: Witness the strange event referenced by the trophy description. Explore unusual locations and side content in Leonida; when you encounter the event, stay through the full scene/interaction so the trophy registers. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Ten Pin
trophies.description: Bowl 'em over with a melee drive-by.
trophies.guide: Knock someone down using a melee drive-by. While driving or riding in a vehicle, use a melee attack as you pass a pedestrian or enemy to bowl them over. Try at low speed so you can line up the hit. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Dime on the Dollar
trophies.description: Earn $250,000 laundering Marked Bills through your contacts.
trophies.guide: Launder $250,000 worth of Marked Bills through your contacts. Acquire Marked Bills through gameplay, then use the contact/system that launders them until the total laundered reaches $250,000. Track the cumulative amount if the game provides a counter. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Treat Yo Self
trophies.guide: Spend a total of $100,000 across shops. Buy items, clothing, supplies, or services from shops around Leonida until your cumulative spending reaches $100,000. You can combine purchases across different shop types. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: Little Boxes
trophies.guide: Buy every garage property available. Locate all garage properties on the map, save enough money, and purchase each one. Confirm the game counts all required garages before moving on. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.

trophies.name: On the Spot
trophies.description: Register 10 vehicles to the Scooter Bros app.
trophies.guide: Register 10 vehicles using the Scooter Bros app. Open the Scooter Bros app in-game, find eligible vehicles, and register them until you have registered ten. Keep track of which vehicles are already registered to avoid duplicates. Source: PlayStation GTA VI trophy list; Exophase GTA VI trophies.
